name: SmolVLM-Instruct (2.2B, Idefics3 arch)
notes: TWO-PART MODEL, the Idefics3 architecture, and the EFFICIENCY DESIGN is the record here. (1) Vision: SigLIP tower, 27 layers, hidden 1152, 16 heads, patch 14, image_size 384, gelu_pytorch_tanh. Naive cost would be (384/14)^2 = 729 patches. Instead: pixel_shuffle / scale_factor 3 compresses before the PERCEIVER RESAMPLER (perceiver_config nested in text_config: resampler_n_latents 64, resampler_depth 6, resampler_head_dim 96, resampler_n_heads 16, num_key_value_heads 1). VISION TOKENS = FIXED, AT 64 PER IMAGE, REGARDLESS OF RESOLUTION. image_seq_len is 81 (64 image tokens + 16 text tokens carrying the global view). vision_config.size.longest_edge 1920 vs max_image_size.longest_edge 384 means the image is tiled for the encoder and then collapsed to those 64 latents, so the LLM never sees more than 64 vision tokens however large the input. DOMINANCE: TEXT DOMINATES, decisively and by design -- 64 vision tokens is smaller than a single sentence. This is the deliberate opposite of Gemma 3 (4,096 tokens) and Pixtral (4,096 per tile), and it is why SmolVLM is the cheapest VLM in this slice to prefill. The tradeoff is lost detail. (2) LLM: VLlama3 dense decoder, 24 layers, hidden 2048, 32 heads AND 32 KV heads, head_dim 64, intermediate 8192, vocab 49,155 (Llama-3 tokenizer), max_position 16,384. ARCHITECTURE = dense. KV CACHE: 24 * 32 * 64 * 2 * 2 = 196,608 B/token (192 KiB) -- MHA, no GQA at all. This is 3.4x Qwen2.5-VL-7B's per-token KV on a model a third the size, and it is the one genuinely bad serving number in this record. At 16,384 ctx that is 3.0 GiB per sequence. If you shrink vision tokens to 64, spend the budget on KV head reduction instead. params_b 2.246 = HF API safetensors total (2,246,272,880).
